title: A stamped row written at the counter ceiling keeps its order after the record is read again
evidence: Found in the R9 PR 1 review (2026-11-27). Stamped writers add one to the row lamport (state-edits.ts upsert, setReminderRow; merge.ts stampFields) without the MAX_COUNTER ceiling (merge.ts:80) that migrate.ts counterOf applies on read. A write past the ceiling is clamped back on the next read, so it can tie the row it replaced and fall to the content tie-break. Applies to every stamped writer, not only the reminders opt-in. Needs one rule for the ceiling at write time, with a test per writer.
